description: Contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes used for authentication endpoints in the web layer of the application.

classes.name: AuthDtos
classes.description: A container class for authentication-related DTOs, grouping request and response classes for authentication endpoints.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for login request containing username and password.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginResponse
classes.description: DTO for login response containing access and refresh tokens.

classes.name: AuthDtos.AccessTokenResponse
classes.description: DTO for response containing a new access token.
